ticket: gpui-perf 08: intermittent 'host loop exited' in the inset-shadow real-GPU tests
root_cause: renderInsetPanel's cleanup posts window.Close (an async WM_CLOSE) and then polls window.Alive() through a sync helper that t.Fatalf's when host.Post is dropped. Closing the last window quits the host loop by design (quitOnLastWindow: WM_NCDESTROY -> WM_GPUI_CLOSE_ONE_WINDOW -> PostQuitMessage). When the first poll's Post lands after the quit, Post correctly returns false and the helper fails the test. The poll usually wins because its wake message gets queued ahead of the close-one-window message; the timing is perturbed but not caused by the gpui-perf changes.

failing_tail: inset_shadow_gpu_test.go:78: foreground post was dropped: the host loop exited
passing_tail: [winhost] wake ... / wake drained   <- the Alive poll runs before the quit (reads false)

same_pattern_elsewhere.safe: every other real-window cleanup polls !window.Alive() directly; Alive reports false on a stopped host (queryForeground returns ErrHostStopped)

fix: both cleanups poll !window.Alive() directly instead of through the post-or-fail sync
regression_test: internal/winhostspec TestAlivePollSurvivesQuitOnLastWindow forces the losing side of the race (loop already exited before the first poll): Post reports the drop, Alive reads false

rates.method: one test binary per side, built with CGO_ENABLED=0; scenespec.test -test.run TestInsetShadow -test.count=400 -test.v; real shown windows; run sequentially on the same machine
rates.isolated_before: 0 failures in 150 single-test processes (fresh-process timing; consistent with the 0.5% in-process rate, not proof of a difference)
